references.text: Joshua later gives orders to open the cave and bring out the five kings, which directly follows the command to roll stones in front of the cave entrance.
After the execution, the kings were thrown back into the cave and large stones were placed at the entrance, repeating the motif of stones before the cave opening.
Daniel was cast into the lion's den and a stone was placed before the opening, a similar motif of sealing a cave with a stone.
A large stone was rolled in front of the entrance to Jesus' tomb, reflecting the practice of sealing a cave or grave with large stones.
The tomb was secured with guards and a sealed stone, parallel to setting guards at the cave to watch over those imprisoned inside.
A large pile of stones was raised over Achan, showing the use of large stones as a memorial or seal.
